notes: Minnesota and North Dakota have an income tax reciprocity agreement: wages are taxed only by the state of residence. A North Dakota resident working in Minnesota gives the employer Form MWR; a Minnesota resident working in North Dakota gives Form NDW-R (tax.nd.gov).

Montana and North Dakota have an income tax reciprocity agreement for wages, salaries, commissions and employee fees: "Montana residents earning income in North Dakota pay Montana income tax instead of North Dakota income tax" (MT DOR). A North Dakota resident working in Montana claims exemption on Form MW-4; a Montana resident working in North Dakota gives Form NDW-R.
